title: I Built a Roblox Mecha Combat Game Looking for Feedback!
author: pupfboy
selftext:
If you’ve never used Claude or you’re in a ChatGPT bubble, I highly recommend trying other AI agents. I’m a heavy ChatGPT user, but every time I use Claude, I wonder why I don’t use it more often. I probably stick with ChatGPT because my account has so much history and context.

Either way, I was able to create a fully functional Roblox mecha game with Claude. I tried building it with ChatGPT too, but Claude gave me better results. If you could try it out and give me some feedback, I’d really appreciate it!

[https://www.roblox.com/games/139754504882881/Mech-Battlegrounds](https://www.roblox.com/games/139754504882881/Mech-Battlegrounds)
